claims.claim_text: The entity discloses metrics and targets used to measure and monitor sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, including metrics required by applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards and metrics the entity uses to measure and monitor the risk/opportunity and performance (including progress towards targets and legally required targets).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Metrics and targets (opening paragraph and bullets)
claims.support_notes: Text mirrors IFRS S1 paragraph 46 clauses (a), (b)(i) and (b)(ii) at a policy/requirement level; no entity-specific metrics/targets are provided.

claims.claim_text: When a metric is taken from a source other than IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the entity identifies the source and the metric taken.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Identification and sourcing of metrics (bullet 1)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no examples of external-source metrics or citations are included.

claims.claim_text: In the absence of an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity applies relevant IFRS S1 requirements to identify applicable metrics.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Identification and sourcing of metrics (bullet 2)
claims.support_notes: Draft references applying IFRS S1 requirements; IFRS S1 47 specifically references paragraphs 57–58.

claims.claim_text: Metrics disclosed include metrics associated with particular business models, activities or other common features that characterise participation in an industry.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Identification and sourcing of metrics (bullet 3)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated at a general level; no industry-specific metrics are enumerated.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses how the metric is defined, including whether it is derived by adjusting a metric from a non-IFRS source and, if so, which source and how it differs.
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no entity-developed metric definitions are provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses whether the metric is an absolute measure, a measure expressed in relation to another metric, or a qualitative measure.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Entity-developed metrics (Type of measure bullet)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no classification of specific metrics is included.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses whether the metric is validated by a third party and, if so, which party.
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no named validator is provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses the calculation method and inputs, including limitations and significant assumptions.
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no calculation methodologies are actually disclosed in this section.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses information about targets it has set to monitor progress towards achieving its strategic goals and any targets it is required to meet by law or regulation.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Targets (first bullet list under Targets)
claims.support_notes: High-level requirement stated; the section does not provide any specific targets or legally required targets.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the metric used to set the target and to monitor progress towards reaching the target.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Targets ("For each target" list item 1)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no target-specific metric is provided.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the specific quantitative or qualitative target it has set or is required to meet.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Targets ("For each target" list item 2)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no quantitative/qualitative target values are included.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the period over which the target applies and the base period from which progress is measured.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Targets ("For each target" list items 3 and 4)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no periods/base years are provided.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses any milestones and interim targets, performance against each target with trend analysis, and any revisions to the target with explanations.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Targets ("For each target" list items 5, 6 and 7)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no milestones, performance results, trends, or revisions are disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The definition and calculation of metrics (including metrics used to set targets and monitor progress) are applied consistently over time.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 1)
claims.support_notes: Consistency principle stated; no evidence of actual consistent application is provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric is redefined or replaced in the reporting period, the entity discloses a revised comparative amount (unless impracticable), explains the changes, and explains the reasons for those changes.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 2)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no redefinitions/replacements or comparative amounts are presented.

claims.claim_text: If the entity introduces a new metric in the reporting period, it discloses a comparative amount for that metric unless impracticable.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 3)
claims.support_notes: The supported_requirements list is truncated after IFRS_S1_B53_C01, so the full requirement text is not available in the provided context to verify; the draft statement aligns with IFRS S1 B53 but cannot be fully evidenced from the truncated input.

claims.claim_text: If new information is identified relating to an estimated amount disclosed in the preceding period and it provides evidence of circumstances that existed in that period, the entity discloses a revised comparative amount, the difference versus the previously disclosed amount, and the reasons for revising the comparative amount.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 4)
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no estimated amounts or revisions are disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The entity labels and defines metrics and targets using meaningful, clear and precise names and descriptions.
claims.support_notes: Requirement stated; no actual metric/target labels are shown in this section.
